# Command line reference

<!-- generated by docs/gen_reference.py from the code: do not edit by hand -->

Every command takes the dataset folder as its first argument. Commands exit with status 1 on an error (`validate` and `check-video` also do when they find problems), so they work in scripts and CI.

## `init`

Create an empty dataset.

```
vidlabel init path
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |

## `info`

Show what is in a dataset.

```
vidlabel info path
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |

## `validate`

Check a dataset against the spec. Exit code 1 if there are errors.

```
vidlabel validate path [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--deep` / `--no-deep` | off | Also decode every mask and cross-check its box. |

## `build`

Compile the sorted training table; prints the release id to pin.

```
vidlabel build path [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--include-rejected` / `--no-include-rejected` | off | Also put rejected annotations in the release. |

## `add-video`

Probe a video file with ffprobe and register it, with its frame index.

```
vidlabel add-video path video_file [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_file` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--video-id` | none | Id to register it under. Default: the file name without extension. |
| `--no-hash` | off | Skip hashing the file (faster, weaker identity). |
| `--no-index` | off | Skip the frame index (timestamps and keyframes; see `vidlabel index`). |

## `index`

Make (or rebuild) the frame index of registered videos: per-frame timestamps and keyframes, read without decoding.

```
vidlabel index path video_ids... [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_ids` | optional |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--video-path` | none | Video file, if the recorded path is stale (one video only). |
| `--root` | none | Folder(s) to search for the videos by file name. |
| `--force` / `--no-force` | off | Rebuild indexes that already exist. |
| `--no-verify` | off | Do not check the file's hash against the registered one (faster). |

## `derive-view`

Copy the whole-frame rows that lie inside a view (frames, region, labels) into that view. Safe to run again.

```
vidlabel derive-view path video_id view_id [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_id` | required |
| `view_id` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--label` | none | Only these labels (repeat for several). |
| `--origin` | none | Only rows with these origins (repeat for several). |

## `tracks`

List the tracks of a video: label, frames, how many rows, mean confidence and review status of each.

```
vidlabel tracks path video_id [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_id` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--view` | none | Tracks made in this view (default: whole-frame rows). |

## `review`

Approve or reject whole tracks at once.

```
vidlabel review path video_id [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_id` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--track` | none | Track id to change (repeat for several). |
| `--status` | none | unreviewed, approved or rejected. |
| `--view` | none | The track was made in this view (default: whole-frame rows). |

## `add-labels`

Add labels to the shared vocabulary.

```
vidlabel add-labels path labels...
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `labels` | required |

## `add-view`

Define a crop and/or time ranges of a video.

```
vidlabel add-view path view_id video_id [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `view_id` | required |
| `video_id` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--region` | none | x,y,width,height in displayed pixels |
| `--frames` | none | first,last frame (inclusive); repeat for several time windows |
| `--output-size` | none | width,height the crop is resized to, if resized |
| `--labels` | none | comma-separated labels allowed in this view |

## `preview`

Draw the annotations on frames of the real video, to check they line up. Needs OpenCV (the video extra).

```
vidlabel preview path video_id [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_id` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--out` | `preview_out` | Output folder. |
| `--frames` | none | e.g. '0-100,250'. Default: a spread of annotated frames. |
| `--every` | `1` | With --frames, keep every Nth frame. |
| `--view` | none | Show this view's crop and only its annotations. |
| `--mp4` / `--no-mp4` | off | Write one MP4 instead of PNG images. |
| `--video-path` | none | Video file, if the recorded path is stale. |
| `--root` | none | Folder(s) to search for the video by file name. |
| `--color` | none | Box colour: 'red', '#ff8800' or '255,136,0' for all labels, or per label: 'person=red;car=#00ff00'. Default: one colour per label. |
| `--thickness` | none | Box line width in pixels. Default: scales with the video. |
| `--font-scale` | none | Label text size, e.g. 0.8. Default: scales with the video. |
| `--labels` / `--no-labels` | on | Write label text next to boxes. |
| `--outline` / `--no-outline` | on | Dark border around boxes and text. |

## `check-video`

Check that the video file on disk matches the metadata, and report how costly random access is (keyframe spacing).

```
vidlabel check-video path video_id [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `video_id` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--video-path` | none | Video file, if the recorded path is stale. |
| `--root` | none | Folder(s) to search for the video by file name. |
| `--hash` / `--no-hash` | off | Also verify the content hash (reads the whole file). |
| `--seek` / `--no-seek` | off | Also test that random-access seeking returns exactly the right frames (decodes the whole video once). |

## `cache`

Save the frames a training run will use as image files, so random access is a file read. The cache is derived data:
delete and rebuild it any time. Pass it to FrameSamples(cache=...).

```
vidlabel cache path out [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | required |
| `out` | required |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--release` | `latest` | Release to take the frames from: 'latest', a release id, or 'none' for the live annotations. |
| `--view` | none | Only the frames this view samples. |
| `--frames` | `annotated` | 'annotated' (frames with annotations) or 'all'. |
| `--format` | `jpg` | 'jpg' (small, slightly lossy) or 'png' (exact pixels, larger). |
| `--quality` | `95` | JPEG quality, 1-100. |
| `--root` | none | Folder(s) to search for the videos by file name. |
| `--overwrite` / `--no-overwrite` | off | Re-decode frames that are already cached. |

## `ui`

Open the local web interface. Needs `pip install "vidlabel[ui]"`.

```
vidlabel ui path [options]
```

| argument | |
|---|---|
| `path` | optional |

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--host` | `127.0.0.1` | Address to listen on. The default is this computer only; use 0.0.0.0 to share on your network. |
| `--port` | `8765` | Port. If it is busy the next free one is used. |
| `--no-browser` | off | Do not open a browser window. |
| `--fs-root` | none | Only allow the file picker inside this folder (repeat for more). Required for file access when sharing. |
| `--token` | none | Use this access token instead of a random one (so a shared address stays the same). |

## `schema`

Print (or write) the JSON Schema of the spec.

```
vidlabel schema [options]
```

| option | default | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--out` | none | Write the JSON Schema to this file instead of printing it. |
